description: An interface defining generic mapping methods for converting between entity objects and Data Transfer Objects (DTOs), including batch conversion.

classes.name: BaseMapper
classes.description: A generic interface for mapping between entities and DTOs, facilitating conversions of single objects and lists.

methods.name: toDtoList
methods.description: Converts a list of entity objects to a list of DTO objects.

methods.name: toDto
methods.description: Converts a single entity object to its corresponding DTO.

methods.name: toEntity
methods.description: Converts a DTO back to its entity object.
